items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: He say, I want you to go to Miami, open a club called the Mogambo... So we go to open the Mogambo.

ctx.x: So by name Phil Lander (phonetic), yes, he came to me. He say, I want you to go to Miami, open a club called the Mogambo. I say, I don't think I'm interested in that because I know there's no color (inaudible) no color band (inaudible) Miami rich. They don't allow. He say, yeah, but you going to be the first one.

And I'm thinking -- you see, I don't want to take that kind of risk. I've been to Miami a million times with A the color ban, I know what it is. And we never played the other side, because we can't (inaudible), and I know what it is, you see. Never mind; you're going with me. I said, all right. So we go to open the Mogambo.
